description: Core interface and lifecycle specifications for modern LibXposed framework

classes.name: io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface
classes.summary: Core interface providing operations for modules on application processes (hooking, invokers, remote preferences, logging, deoptimization).

constants.name: API_101
constants.doc: Initial modern API level. Modules cannot inject into zygote; loaded only in target app process scope.

constants.name: API_102
constants.doc: API level 102. Introduces hot reloading, hook IDs and atomic replacement, and blocks legacy de.robv.android.xposed calls.

constants.name: LIB_API
constants.doc: Static version of the compile-time library API.

constants.name: PROP_CAP_SYSTEM
constants.doc: Framework capability: can hook system_server and system processes.

constants.name: PROP_CAP_REMOTE
constants.doc: Framework capability: supports remote preferences and remote files.

constants.name: PROP_RT_API_PROTECTION
constants.doc: Framework runtime property: disallows accessing Xposed API via reflection or dynamically loaded code.

constants.name: PRIORITY_LOWEST
constants.doc: Executes at the end of the interceptor chain.

constants.name: PRIORITY_HIGHEST
constants.doc: Executes at the beginning of the interceptor chain.

methods.name: hook
params: origin: Executable (Method or Constructor to hook)
methods.doc: Initiates hook creation for a method or constructor. Returns a fluent HookBuilder.

methods.name: hookClassInitializer
params: origin: Class<?> whose static initializer (<clinit>) to hook
methods.doc: Hooks class static initializer (<clinit>). Treated as static void() with no args. If class is already initialized, hook will never trigger.

methods.name: deoptimize
methods.doc: Forces ART to deoptimize the caller to prevent inlining of small methods that prevent hooks from executing.

methods.name: getInvoker
methods.doc: Gets an invoker bypassing access checks. Can be configured to invoke original method or specific chain slice via setType().

methods.name: getInvoker
methods.doc: Gets a constructor invoker to create instances bypassing access checks or with special initialization.

methods.name: getApiVersion
methods.doc: Returns the runtime Xposed framework API level (e.g. 101 or 102).

methods.name: getFrameworkName
methods.doc: Returns framework implementation name (e.g. LSPosed).

methods.name: getFrameworkVersion
methods.doc: Returns framework version string.

methods.name: getFrameworkVersionCode
methods.doc: Returns framework version code.

methods.name: getFrameworkProperties
methods.doc: Returns bitmask of framework capabilities and runtime properties.

methods.name: log
methods.signature: void log(int priority, @Nullable String tag, @NonNull String msg, @Nullable Throwable tr = null)
methods.doc: Writes a message to the Xposed system log.

methods.name: getModuleApplicationInfo
methods.doc: Returns the ApplicationInfo for the module itself (sourceDir, nativeLibraryDir, etc.).

methods.name: getRemotePreferences
methods.doc: Retrieves read-only cross-process preferences stored in the Xposed framework for this module.

methods.name: listRemoteFiles
methods.doc: Lists files in the module's shared data directory provided by the framework.

methods.name: openRemoteFile
methods.signature: ParcelFileDescriptor openRemoteFile(@NonNull String name) throws FileNotFoundException
methods.doc: Opens a read-only ParcelFileDescriptor to a file in module's shared data directory.

classes.name: io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.Hooker
classes.summary: Functional interface for intercepting method or constructor calls.

methods.name: intercept
methods.signature: Object intercept(@NonNull Chain chain) throws Throwable
methods.doc: Intercepts execution. Call chain.proceed() to execute target or next hooker. Modify return value or throw exceptions as needed. For void/constructors, return value is ignored.

classes.name: io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.Chain
classes.summary: Represents the ongoing interception execution chain.

methods.name: getExecutable
methods.doc: Returns the method or constructor being hooked.

methods.name: getThisObject
methods.doc: Returns receiver object, or null for static methods.

methods.name: getArgs
methods.doc: Returns immutable list of current arguments.

methods.name: getArg
methods.doc: Returns argument at specified index with bounds checking.

methods.name: proceed
methods.doc: Proceeds down chain with original arguments and receiver.

methods.name: proceed
methods.signature: Object proceed(@NonNull Object[] args) throws Throwable
methods.doc: Proceeds down chain with replaced arguments.

methods.name: proceedWith
methods.signature: Object proceedWith(@NonNull Object thisObject) throws Throwable
methods.doc: Proceeds down chain with replaced receiver.

methods.name: proceedWith
methods.signature: Object proceedWith(@NonNull Object thisObject, @NonNull Object[] args) throws Throwable
methods.doc: Proceeds down chain with replaced receiver and arguments.

classes.name: io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.HookHandle
classes.summary: Handle returned when a hook is registered. Allows unhooking and atomic replacement.

methods.name: getExecutable
methods.doc: Gets the hooked executable.

methods.name: unhook
methods.doc: Removes the hook. Idempotent.

methods.name: getId
methods.doc: Gets the unique hook ID, or null.

methods.name: replaceHook
methods.doc: Atomically replaces this hook with a new hooker without changing priority, exception mode, or ID.

classes.name: io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.HookBuilder
classes.summary: Fluent builder for configuring a hook.

methods.name: setPriority
methods.doc: Sets priority (higher runs earlier).

methods.name: setExceptionMode
methods.doc: Sets DEFAULT, PROTECTIVE, or PASSTHROUGH.

methods.name: setId
methods.doc: Sets hook ID for atomic replacement across reloads.

methods.name: intercept
methods.doc: Attaches hooker and registers the hook.

classes.name: io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.Invoker
classes.summary: Invoker for method calls bypassing access checks.

methods.name: setType
methods.doc: Sets invocation type: Invoker.Type.ORIGIN to skip hooks, or Invoker.Type.Chain to invoke hook chain.

methods.name: invoke
methods.signature: Object invoke(Object thisObject, Object... args) throws ...
methods.doc: Invokes the method (virtual dispatch).

methods.name: invokeSpecial
methods.signature: Object invokeSpecial(@NonNull Object thisObject, Object... args) throws ...
methods.doc: Invokes non-virtual method directly on class (similar to super call).

classes.name: io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.CtorInvoker
classes.summary: Invoker for constructor calls bypassing access checks.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.doc: Instantiates object through constructor.

methods.name: newInstanceSpecial
methods.signature: <U> U newInstanceSpecial(@NonNull Class<U> subClass, Object... args) throws ...
methods.doc: Instantiates subclass initialized with parent constructor.

classes.name: io.github.libxposed.api.XposedModule
classes.summary: Base class that every modern LibXposed module entry must extend.

methods.name: onModuleLoaded
methods.doc: Called when the module is loaded into target process.

methods.name: onPackageLoaded
methods.doc: Called when an APK package has loaded.

methods.name: onPackageReady
methods.doc: Called when application classloader and context are fully initialized. Recommended place for most hooks.

methods.name: onSystemServerStarting
methods.doc: Called when Android system_server is starting.

methods.name: onHotReloading
methods.doc: Called before hot reload occurs. Return true to proceed, save state with param.setSavedInstanceState().

methods.name: onHotReloaded
methods.doc: Called after hot reload succeeds. Restore state and clean old hooks via param.getOldHookHandles().

classes.name: io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterfaceWrapper
classes.summary: Wrapper of XposedInterface used by module entry classes to shield framework implementation details and manage entry detachment.

methods.name: detach
methods.doc: Stops all subsequent lifecycle callbacks (onPackageLoaded, onHotReloading, etc.) for the current module entry in current process. Only lifecycle callbacks are stopped; all XposedInterface APIs remain functional.

methods.name: attachFramework
methods.signature: public final void attachFramework(@NonNull XposedInterface base, @NonNull Runnable detachImpl)
methods.doc: Internal framework attachment method annotated with @InternalApi. Modules MUST NOT invoke this method directly.

classes.name: io.github.libxposed.api.XposedModuleInterface
classes.summary: Container for lifecycle callback signatures and parameter interfaces (ModuleLoadedParam, PackageLoadedParam, PackageReadyParam, SystemServerStartingParam, HotReloadingParam, HotReloadedParam).

methods.name: onModuleLoaded
methods.doc: Called when initial module generation is loaded into target process.

methods.name: onPackageLoaded
methods.doc: Called when an APK package has loaded into process and default classloader is ready.

methods.name: onPackageReady
methods.doc: Called when AppComponentFactory has instantiated classloader and is ready to create Application. Recommended place for most hooks.

methods.name: onSystemServerStarting
methods.doc: Called when system server is ready to start critical services.

methods.name: onHotReloading
methods.doc: Called in old code before module is reloaded. Return true to allow reload, or false to reject. Save state with param.setSavedInstanceState().

methods.name: onHotReloaded
methods.doc: Called in new code after reload succeeds. Package callbacks are not automatically replayed. Restore state with param.getSavedInstanceState() and replace/unhook old hooks via param.getOldHookHandles().

classes.name: io.github.libxposed.api.error.HookFailedError
classes.summary: Unchecked error thrown when a hook operation fails due to framework internal error.

classes.name: io.github.libxposed.api.error.XposedFrameworkError
classes.summary: Unchecked error thrown when the framework encounters an unrecoverable internal error.
